sloka: विषाणयोर्गृहीत्वा तं दुन्दुभिं गिरिसन्निभम् ।आविध्यत तदा वाली विनदन्कपिकुञ्जरः ॥४-११-४०॥।।
transliteration: viṣāṇayorgṛhītvā taṁ dundubhiṁ girisannibham ।āvidhyata tadā vālī vinadankapikuñjaraḥ ॥4-11-40॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali, the elephantlike monkey then held the mountainlike Dundubhi by the horns and struck him down, roaring loudly.
